review_notes:
I read the whole file (lines 1–176) and checked the proofs for repeated nontrivial reasoning. The file already factors out the common pieces: n172_closure_pair_eq_sup, n172_coe_sup_eq_mul, n172_mem_sup_pair and n172_eq_one_of_mem_of_not_mem. These are reused in card_sup_zpowers_of_not_mem, isHyperplane_closure_pair and mem_zpowers_of_mem_closure_pair.

I found two remaining overlaps, and neither meets the rubric's bar.
1. The surjectivity branch of card_sup_zpowers_of_not_mem repeats the rewrite-and-Set.mem_mul step from n172_mem_sup_pair. It is a two-line routine unfolding, so a helper would not be an improvement.
2. The "subtract a known factor, then apply n172_eq_one_of_mem_of_not_mem" pattern appears in the injectivity branch and in mem_zpowers_of_mem_closure_pair. The two uses differ in setup: one is cancellation between pairs, the other is a single decomposition. A shared lemma would save only a few lines.

The final theorem zpowers_eq_of_mem_zpowers is a thin public wrapper around the private n172_zpowers_eq_of_mem_zpowers. That is a redundancy, but it is not repeated proof machinery, so I did not report it.

I did not search other files for the same pattern. My one uncertainty is whether duplicates exist elsewhere in the repository, and that is outside this single-file review.
